hero.headline: Learning that adapts to every child
hero.subtitle: OpenEdu brings interactive lessons, smart widgets, and an AI companion to any device — online or off. Free, open, and built for everyone.
hero.prism_title: Order the colors of a rainbow
prism.question: Which order does light split into a rainbow?
prism.instructions: Drag each color tile into the correct slot.
prism.success: Correct! Light splits into red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet.
prism.error: Not quite — check the order and try again.
why.title: A platform built for the way kids actually learn
why.subtitle: Everything you need to deliver rich, adaptive learning — without a closed ecosystem.
why.interactive.title: Interactive by default
why.interactive.description: Lessons come alive with quizzes, timelines, diagrams, and drag-and-drop activities that keep learners engaged.
why.offline.title: Works offline
why.offline.description: Courses bundle into compact .oep archives that run fully offline — perfect for low-connectivity classrooms.
why.ai.title: A friendly AI companion
why.ai.description: Pipili answers questions, explains concepts, and nudges learners forward with hints instead of answers.
why.open.title: Open source, open formats
why.open.description: Content is plain Markdown + JSON. Anyone can author, audit, and share courses freely.
why.accessible.title: Accessible by design
why.accessible.description: Every lesson passes WCAG AA audits with keyboard navigation, screen-reader support, and high-contrast themes.
why.global.title: Global and multilingual
why.global.description: Learners can switch languages and see content in Hindi, Odia, and more — right from the settings.
courses.title: Discover a course for every curiosity
courses.subtitle: Sample lessons from across the OpenEdu catalog. Filter by category and see how courses come alive.
courses.course_indian_tribal_art_desc: Discover the colors, patterns, and stories behind India's living tribal art traditions.
courses.course_world_of_atoms_desc: Zoom into matter and meet the tiny particles that make up everything around us.
courses.course_ancient_civilizations_des: Travel back to the river valleys and cities that shaped human history.
courses.course_shapes_in_real_world_desc: Spot circles, triangles, and symmetry in buildings, nature, and everyday objects.
courses.course_mindful_moments_desc: Simple breathing, focus, and gratitude practices for calmer days.

ai.title: A learning companion that never runs out of patience
ai.subtitle: Pipili turns curiosity into understanding — answering questions, guiding hints, and celebrating every step.
ai.greeting: Hi! I'm Pipili. Ask me anything about what you're learning — I love curious questions.
ai.response_sky: Sunlight is a mix of colors. Air scatters blue light more than other colors, so the sky looks blue. At sunset, the light travels further and reds and oranges shine through!
ai.response_volcanoes: Deep underground, hot molten rock called magma rises through cracks in Earth's crust. When pressure builds, it erupts as lava, ash, and gases — building a volcano over time.
offline.title: Full lessons with zero connection
offline.subtitle: Courses pack into portable .oep archives. Download once, and the whole lesson works — even on a plane.
everyone.title: Built for the whole learning village
everyone.subtitle: Whether you teach one child or a thousand, OpenEdu adapts to your needs.
everyone.learners.title: Learners

everyone.educators.title: Educators

everyone.parents.title: Parents

everyone.developers.title: Developers
